lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-luminance, circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid pattern across the central lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating visible anchor nodes where the bands and spots intersect, particularly in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced lower values on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish attached to the ventral area beneath the pectoral fin and along the lower abdominal region.
